stories.headline: Postgres LISTEN/NOTIFY actually scales
stories.summary: Postgres LISTEN/NOTIFY has a bad reputation thanks in part to a popular blog post asserting it does not scale .  If that were true, it would be a shame, because LISTEN/NOTIFY is a powerful tool, allowing you to use your Postgres database for low-latency durable notifications, streams, and pub/sub.
